question: The ball colour in the sport of Ball Badminton should be:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yellow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ball Badminton** is played with a** yellow-coloured ball**.
 
• The **yellow ball** is used for** better visibility during gameplay**.
 
• It distinguishes the ball from the surroundings and facilitates tracking during **fast-paced movements**.
 
• The colour helps players **react swiftly and accurately during matches**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Green-coloured balls** are used in **several sports**, including:

 
 
• **Lawn bowls**
 
• **Padel tennis**
 
• Some varieties of **squash**
 
 
 
• **Pink-coloured balls **are primarily used in:
 
 
• **Designed for better visibility** under **floodlights**.
 
• **Cricket**, specifically **day-night Test matches** and **limited-over matches**.
 
 
 
• **Red-coloured balls **are primarily used in **various sports,** including:
 
 
• **Rugby: Red balls** are used in **rugby matches,** especially in **training sessions**.
 
• **Hockey: Red balls** are used in f**ield hockey matches**.
 
• **Soccer:** Some soccer leagues use **red-coloured balls** for matches played in adverse **weather conditions **like heavy **snow or fog**.
 
• **Tennis: **Standard tennis balls used in professional and amateur tennis matches.
 
• **Cricket: **Traditional cricket balls used in T**est matches **and most longer-format games.
